QF.id: VB Fund Distribution and Channel Management_26

question.text: Under the SEBI (Prohibition of Fraudulent and Unfair Trade Practices) Regulations 2003, mis-selling in mutual funds includes all of the following EXCEPT __________.

answer.text: Recommending a scheme after conducting a proper risk assessment and suitability analysis of the investor
Making false or misleading statements to induce the purchase or sale of mutual fund units
Concealing or omitting material facts about the scheme from the investor
Not taking reasonable care to ensure suitability of the scheme for the investor

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, mis-selling/fraudulent practices include four elements: (1) making false or misleading statements, (2) concealing or omitting material facts, (3) concealing associated risk factors, and (4) not taking reasonable care to ensure suitability. Recommending a scheme after a proper risk and suitability assessment is the correct practice and is not mis-selling. The Trap: All three distractor options are actual components of the mis-selling definition. The EXCEPT phrasing requires identifying the one practice that is not mis-selling. Note: Proper suitability assessment is the practice that distinguishes acceptable advice from the four prohibited mis-selling activities.
